name: Manasses
description: Judith's husband, of her tribe and kindred, who died of heatstroke overseeing the barley harvest at Bethulia and was buried with his fathers between Dothaim and Balamo; left Judith gold, silver, servants, cattle and lands; Judith wore the garments of gladness she had worn during his life and was buried beside him in the cave at Bethulia when she died

points: Judith was of the tribe of Simeon. Her husband Manasses was a man of position — he had people binding sheaves in his field, and he left her resources.
